Vadodara is Gujarat's engineering and chemical heart. The Nandesari belt runs chemicals and petrochemicals, Makarpura is packed with heavy-engineering names like L&T, ABB and Siemens, and the Halol belt builds cars. All of it runs project and process sites that need clean, lockable, compliance-ready site offices. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer, not a marketplace reseller; we supply a Prefab Container Office for Site Use in Vadodara and dispatch it from our Greater Noida factory. This page covers what Vadodara buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Vadodara

Chemical and petrochemical contractors at Nandesari use them as project offices, permit and safety rooms, and supervisor cabins where documentation and access control matter. Heavy-engineering units at Makarpura use them as site and QC cabins. Auto and ancillary units at Halol use them as production-supervisor cabins. EPC and infrastructure contractors across the district use them as construction site offices and security posts. The common need is a rugged, well-finished unit that arrives ready and suits a demanding process-industry environment.

Vadodara industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the district's main GIDC belts:

  • Makarpura GIDC / M.I. Estate (390010) — the heavy-engineering and electricals cluster; project offices, QC rooms and supervisor cabins.
  • Nandesari GIDC (391340) — the chemical and petrochemical belt north of the city; safety and project cabins built for process-site conditions.
  • Savli–Manjusar GIDC (391775) — the newer engineering, rail/metro and pharma estate; site offices and storage-cum-office units.
  • Halol GIDC (389350) — the auto and manufacturing belt to the east; production-supervisor and admin cabins.

Sites outside these pockets — Por-Ramangamdi, Waghodia or along the Vadodara–Halol road — are also served; share the location when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Vadodara
10 ft10 × 8 ftGate/security cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 × 8 ftSite office, admin cabin, safety/permit room
40 ft40 × 8 ftMulti-desk project office, safety room + store

Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board, insulated
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision

Customisation options

Vadodara orders are usually customised for the site and the use. We can add: partition walls for separate cabins; AC provision and extra insulation for admin and control-room use; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; extra corrosion protection for the Nandesari chemical belt; and ramps or external steps. For one-off requirements we can build a prefabricated container office for GIDC sites to your exact layout. Tell us the team size, the site conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in Vadodara

We manufacture near Greater Noida and dispatch to Vadodara by road, roughly 1,000 km via the Delhi–Mumbai Expressway / NH48 corridor. A default delivery charge of ₹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport confirmed by site distance and access; given the distance we confirm a realistic transit window at order stage. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. We serve container offices delivered to Ahmedabad on the same Gujarat network, so the route is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1–2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20–25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house, you deal with the manufacturer on specification, price, documentation and after-sales — which matters on chemical and heavy-industry sites. We supply across West and North India, including container offices we deliver to Mumbai and container offices we build for Jaipur.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Vadodara depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel and insulation type, corrosion protection for chemical-belt sites, partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and the long-haul transport to your site. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

How much does a container office cost in Vadodara?

Price depends on size, insulation, corrosion protection, partitions, electricals and fit-out, plus the transport. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft project office sit far apart on cost. We quote to your exact specification — share your requirement for an itemised price.

How long does delivery take to Vadodara?

Vadodara is roughly 1,000 km from our Greater Noida factory. We confirm a realistic transit window at order stage based on your site location and access, and dispatch once the unit is built.

Are the units suitable for Nandesari chemical and process sites?

Yes. We can add extra corrosion protection, safety/permit-room layouts and the insulation and fit-out your site needs for chemical and process-industry positions. Tell us the conditions and intended use and we configure accordingly.

Can the container office be moved between sites later?

Yes. Container offices are relocatable. If you expect to shift the unit between project sites, tell us at order stage so we specify lifting points and a shell suited to repeated handling.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your Vadodara container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
